Heads up and join the GiG! Be a pioneer and make your mark in our hometown's very first WCA event!
​
This is the first-ever speedcubing competition to be held in the City of Gapan, Nueva Ecija. Our goal is to grow the local speedcubing community by bringing together cubers of all ages in a fun, welcoming, and competitive environment. 

The competition is officially sponsored and held in partnership with GANCUBE, one of the leading brands in speedcubing innovation, whose support helps elevate the overall competition experience for all participants.
